title: Security questionnaire credits & self-serve template marketplace
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers repeatedly ask for bespoke SIG/CAIQ bundles and short-form attestations; sales/legal spends hours stitching evidence. Current process is manual, inconsistent, and blocks deals >$250k. Goal: deliver a self-serve marketplace of verified response templates + an experiment that ties a small bundle of free "questionnaire credits" to product tiers to accelerate evaluation while protecting support load. Scope: build catalog UI (console), backend endpoints to assemble evidence artifacts, automated minimal-evidence generator for common asks, pricing experiment (credit allotments by tier and overage pricing), and analytics to measure time-to-contract and support deflection. Out of scope: full automation of custom questionnaires for regulated industries (separate Private deployment initiative).

Proposed solution: 1) Template marketplace: curate canonical SIG/CAIQ response templates (legal-reviewed), tag by complexity and evidence burden. 2) Credits system: each customer receives X free questionnaire credits on signup/upgrade; credits redeem to auto-generate a filled questionnaire and an evidence bundle. 3) Evidence minimization engine: heuristics to include the smallest set of artifacts (policy docs, TLS certs, SOC summary) required for a given template. 4) Pricing experiment: A/B cohorts—control (manual request) vs. treatment (self-serve credits) measure conversion velocity and average deal size. 5) Guardrails: require security review for templates flagged high-risk; include escalation flow to Solutions Engineering.

Success metrics: decrease median time-to-contract for security-review customers by 30% in 90 days; reduce security support ticket volume related to questionnaire assembly by 40%; retain ARR uplift from faster closes; maintain low fraud/overage cost.

Acceptance criteria: console UI prototype linked; backend endpoint to return assembled bundle with evidence artifacts; legal sign-off on initial 10 templates; experiment cohorts set and telemetry in Mixpanel/Amplitude; rollout doc and support playbook.
